data.body:
**[P1] Run customer transforms outside the plugin lock**

`_emit()` invokes configured content transforms and result overrides while the calling hook holds `self._lock`. If callbacks from overlapping invocations re-enter each other's hooks, each thread holds one plugin lock while waiting for the other, deadlocking both invocations until timeout. `_hook_frame` defers drains and record releases but leaves these callbacks inside the lock. Snapshot state and increment the revision under the lock, run customer callbacks unlocked, then reacquire the lock to revalidate state and schedule atomically. Add a barrier-based reciprocal callback re-entry test.
